3 عَاطَشَهُ فَعَطَشَهُ [aor. of the latter, accord. to general rule,
عَطُشَ , He vied with him in endeavouring to satisfy, (see 6,) or in bearing, thirst, and surpassed him therein]. (O, K, TA. [But whether sanctioned by usage, seems to be doubtful.])
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
